query:
SELECT 
  DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') as month,
  COUNT(*) as item_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT productName) as unique_products,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sku) as unique_skus
FROM inventory
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') IN ('2026-05', '2026-06')
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY month;
